crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of…
Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell…
A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against Yahweh, this same king Ahaz.
O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn’t repent of their works.

translations.web: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
translations.bsb: But the other one rebuked him, saying, “Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same judgment?
translations.kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
translations.asv: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, Dost thou not even fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
